name: roadrunner-author-scenario
description: Create and edit RoadRunner scenarios in MATLAB with roadrunnerAPI: add actors, routes and phase logic, validate and repair a scenario, or recreate an OpenSCENARIO 1.x (.xosc) file as an editable scenario. Use when building a RoadRunner scenario from a description (cut-in, pedestrian crossing, lead-follow and similar), fixing one that fails validation, or rebuilding, recreating or converting a .xosc file in MATLAB. Do NOT use when the user says "import" a .xosc file — call importScenario instead. Not for exporting to OpenSCENARIO, simulation (use roadrunner-simulate-scenario), recorded sensor data (use matlab-use-scenario-builder), Euro NCAP protocol tests (use matlab-use-ncap-protocol), drivingScenario/Driving Scenario Designer scenarios, or OpenSCENARIO 2.x (.osc) files. Triggers on: roadrunnerAPI, RoadRunner scenario authoring, add actor, create route, phase logic, cut-in scenario, pedestrian crossing, scenario from MATLAB, OpenSCENARIO, xosc to MATLAB, recreate xosc.
